Venom Fishing
Instant

Imbued within The Coiled Isle are rivers of acidic venom certain to thwart successful fishing attempts from even the most seasoned anglers.

Pools found in this zone:
- Bubbling Beryl
- Willow Sea
- Viscous Venom
- Vile Venom
- Vile Oddities
